{{Short description|Professor of Inorganic Chemistry}}
{{Orphan|date=August 2020}}

'''Greta R. Patzke''' (born 2 March 1974 in Bremen) is Professor of Inorganic Chemistry at the [[University of Zurich]].<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=Greta Patzke's Group Website|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://patzke.ch/groupleader/|url-status=dead|format=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151030023844/http://patzke.ch/groupleader/|archive-date=2015-10-30|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref>

== Life ==
From 1993 to 1997 she studied chemistry at [[Leibniz University Hannover]].<ref name=":0" />  Her diploma thesis dealt with solid-state chemistry and [[computational chemistry]].<ref name=":0" /> From 1997 to 1999 she completed her dissertation at Leibniz University in the group of Michael Binnewies.<ref name=":0" /> This dissertation dealt with the synthesis, characterization and properties of mixed oxides.<ref name=":0" /> In the group of Reinhard Nesper at the ETH Zurich she worked on her habilitation from 1999 on.<ref name=":0" /> During this time she worked on inorganic structural chemistry, the synthesis of nanomaterials and the systematic application and investigation of hydrothermal techniques.<ref name=":0" /> From 2007 to 2013, Greta Patzke was Assistant Professor of Inorganic Chemistry at the [[University of Zurich]] ([[Swiss National Science Foundation]]'s funded professorship).<ref name=":0" /> In spring 2013 she was promoted to Associate Professor.<ref name=":0" /> Since May 2016 she is Full Professor.<ref name=":0" /> Since 2017 she is part of the institute's Board of Directors.<ref name=":0" />

== Prizes and awards ==
* 2017 Credit Suisse Award for Best Teaching <ref>{{cite web|title=Lehrpreis der Universität Zürich 2017 (Credit Suisse Award for Best Teaching)|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://www.uzh.ch/cmsssl/de/about/portrait/awards/teaching/2017.html|url-status=dead|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201126144249/https://www.uzh.ch/cmsssl/de/about/portrait/awards/teaching/2017.html|archive-date=2020-11-26|last=|date=|year=|language=de|pages=|quote=}}</ref><ref name=":0" />
* 07/1993 Gold medal at the 25th International Chemistry Olympiad in Italy (13th overall place worldwide) <ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Aufgabenbuch Chemieolympiade mit Ergebnislisten|periodical=|publisher=|url=https://wettbewerbe.ipn.uni-kiel.de/icho/aufgaben/archiv/Aufgabenbuch_2019.pdf|url-status=dead|format=|access-date=|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200930060000/http://wettbewerbe.ipn.uni-kiel.de/icho/aufgaben/archiv/Aufgabenbuch_2019.pdf|archive-date=2020-09-30|last=|date=|year=|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref>
